summary: Implemented custom global generators. Unknown generator names are now loaded from <conan cache>/extensions/generators/<name>.py, and the file must define a class with the same name. Built-in generators still take precedence. Changes: added ClientCache.generators_path in conans/client/cache/cache.py; added custom-loading logic and an optional cache_generators_folder parameter to write_generators in conans/client/generators/__init__.py; passed the cache path from conans/client/installer.py (two call sites) and conan/api/subapi/install.py. Not run or tested, per instructions. Nothing committed. No tests added. Docs and changelog were not updated in this repo.
